posts.text: Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era of prosperity.' Cool. Meanwhile my rent went up again. Show me the numbers, not the ribbons. #Veloria2025

Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.

Read the Kito TV debate transcript twice. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but she dodged the question on what happens to them after 2026. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing too, and nobody pressed him hard enough on it. Both owe us the arithmetic.
Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway while my fertiliser bill doubled. Nice road. Still can't afford the diesel to drive on it. #Veloria #Election
Watched the debate tonight. Arden says 200k jobs but nobody asked him how he pays for it. Ostrand's inflation numbers didn't land for me either. Ask the hard questions of both before you vote.

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2, 11 days to the vote. VeriCheck found Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and that the '40% fuel' claim uses a peak month. Economists still put a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Read the checks before you share the numbers. #Veloria2025
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand and nobody in Kessa is talking about it. Try filling a tractor tank on a farmer's budget then tell me the economy's fine. #Veloria #Election

Read VeriCheck's breakdown of Arden's plan. Fair enough that VAT doubling is false. But a ~2% of GDP gap is not small. Both candidates owe us full costings, not just the good-news parts of their numbers.
Before anyone shares a screenshot: check the original source and the full Civic Front plan. Claims like 'DOUBLE VAT' need the actual text. Measure twice, cut once.
posts.orig_text: Read the Kito TV debate transcript twice. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but she dodged the question on what happens to them after 2026. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing too, and nobody pressed him hard enough on it. Both owe us the arithmetic.

posts.text: Kessa traffic this morning was brutal, and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Mara better have a good answer for the detour. Debate was watchable though, she actually had numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Two weeks out and I'm still undecided lol. Ribbons, 200k jobs, costings nobody finishes. Someone just show me a spreadsheet that adds up. #Veloria2025
Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT. Good. But it also says there's a ~2% of GDP gap in the costings. That's the part I want Civic Front to answer before I vote. #Veloria2025

Two weeks out and I'm still hearing the same thing from both sides. Arden's 200k jobs number needs a real plan behind it, and Ostrand's inflation figures need context too. Nurses and ward staff can't live on slogans. Who's actually funding health staffing? That's what I want to hear.

Forwarded WhatsApp 'leaked audio' + a VBC clip that says 'questions raised'. Neither tells me who said what, or if it's real. Before I share anything, I want the source, the full recording, and what the Civic Front actually said. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria2025

Day 3. VBC is reporting 'questions raised' over a recording said to feature Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Don't share the clip until someone has checked where it came from and whether the audio has been verified. Nobody has verified it yet. #Veloria2025
Watched the VBC clip. A recording 'raises questions' but nobody has said who made it, when, or whether it's been verified. Until then I'm waiting for the facts, not the clip. #Veloria2025

VBC played a clip of a 'recording' of Arden and says 'questions raised' lol. Where's the source, who verified it, and why does it drop 3 days out? Civic Front says it's fake. Show me the chain of custody before anyone gets outraged. #Veloria2025

Watched the VBC clip on the Arden recording twice. Nothing in it establishes who is speaking or when it was made. Before we treat it as settled, we need provenance: where it came from, who holds the original file, and whether an independent lab has examined it. Calling it fake is not proof either. Show me the chain of custody.

Played the VBC clip twice. 'Questions raised' is doing a lot of work. Who made it, who verified it, and why is nobody talking about the fuel bill that's actually in my bank statement? #Veloria #Election

Forwarded leaked audio about Arden 'paying the commission' and VBC playing a clip saying 'questions raised'? Hold up. Nobody has verified either. Wait for the source and the Civic Front response before sharing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, and the margin is ±3. That's a coin toss. Good time to ask both for their full costings before we pick. Measure twice. #Veloria2025
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin, so nobody gets to call it. Fuel and fertiliser are still what my bills are about, whoever's ahead. #Veloria #Election

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Before anyone reads it as a verdict, check who commissioned it and how the sample was built. Still want to hear who actually pays for health staffing. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out and the new headline is 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport' from Patriots Daily. Cool. Where's the source, and is the passport even in the official candidate filings? Show me the document before I share anything. Also Kito TV's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so that's a coin flip lol. #Veloria2025

Day 4. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin, so nobody's winning yet. Fuel's still eating my wallet whoever gets in. Check the poll's sample before you quote it. #VeloriaVotes

Read both today's items twice. The Ledger's road-funds story names no documents I can check, and the ministry calls it fabricated. Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so that's a statistical tie. Neither proves anything yet. Show me the documents, and show me the full costings from both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days to the vote. Two things to check before sharing: 'Arden's running mate holds a foreign passport' from Patriots Daily. Where's the source, and what does the candidate list filing actually show? Kito poll is Ostrand 46 / Arden 44, ±3, so it's a statistical tie. Read the methodology, not the headline. #Veloria2025
Read the Ledger piece on the road funds. 'Documents suggest' is not the same as 'documents show'. Ministry says fabricated. Wait for the paper trail before deciding who's lying. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. A WhatsApp message offers 'community ambassador' pay: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid persuasion like that needs a name, a registrar, and a disclosure. Who runs this bot? Before anyone signs up, check the source. Measure twice. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. Commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Anyone with a claim about 'rigged' counts can check the forms there instead of forwarding clips. Sign up for the test if you can. #Veloria2025

Day 5 and the trending tags are both from accounts made THIS MONTH posting the same text within minutes lol. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs are astroturf. Who's paying for the bot farm? Check the account ages before you rage.

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Paid per vote is not a volunteer. Check who's actually behind that bot link before you sign up for anything. Also the Commission is publishing the results forms on VeloResults, so we can all check the counts ourselves. #VeloriaVotes

Two new tags, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, both trending, but researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were created this month and post near-identical text. Before you amplify either, check who's actually posting. #Veloria2025

Day 5. Two weeks out and the #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs tags were both mass-posted by accounts made this month. Before you react to either, look at who's pushing them. Health staffing is what I care about. Who's actually funding it? #Veloria2025

Fuel and fertiliser are still eating my margin, and every poll/debate I see is arguing about ribbons instead. Ostrand's road is nice. Can I afford diesel to drive on it? Ask the numbers questions to BOTH candidates. #Veloria #Election

Read the VeloResults procedure notice twice. Good that observers are invited to a system test. Before the vote, I'd like every polling-station scan to be checkable against the published forms, and both camps' scrutineers in the room. Trust the process we can audit. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'due to security concerns'. Letterhead isn't enough. Check the IECV site or VeloResults for the notice before you tell anyone where to go. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern Province polling stations are moving. Before we share, check IECV's own site and VeloResults. A letterhead isn't proof. If it's real, the Commission will have it published. Measure twice. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round, with her team calling it 'a slip of the tongue'. Fair enough to note, not evidence of anything bigger. Same standard for every clip: where's the original, and is it complete? #Veloria2025

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a provincial town name, team says 'slip of the tongue' lol. Sure. Honest question though: is anyone checking whether the clip is cut or unedited? Show me the full raw footage before I believe either version. #Veloria2025

Got a 'letter' from IECV saying 212 polling stations in the North are moving 'for security'. Who's actually checking that before it goes round WhatsApp? Ask the Commission directly before you pass it on. Fuel still at 40% up here btw. #Veloria #Election

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town name is going viral. 'Slip of the tongue' is her team's line. Fair enough, anyone can stumble on a name. Would rather spend the week on her road funds and Arden's costings than on who can say Kessa properly. #Veloria2025

Watched the Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing the provincial town twice. A slip happens. What matters more is whether her team answers the substantive questions on the economy with the same care. Show me the costings from both camps before we judge either on a single gaffe. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the feeds are about to fill with 'final' clips and 'leaks'. Before you share anything: where's the original, who recorded it, and is it complete? Read the costings, not the clips. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so nobody should be pushing new claims now. Before polls open, I'd ask both camps to publish full costings and let scrutineers see the VeloResults scans. Trust what we can audit. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Reminder: once polls open, the only results to trust are the scanned forms on VeloResults. Not clips, not forwarded 'letters'. Check the source before you share anything else. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The Zuri K 'danger to our children' clip is trending and I can't find the full video or who edited it. Before I share, I want the original upload and the whole speech. Same rule for everyone's clips. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The WhatsApp voice note telling people to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is a voter-suppression red flag, whoever it's from. Don't forward it. Vote, and check results on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Silence starts tonight and the WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Who is 'we'? Anyone telling you not to vote has a reason. Go to your polling station. Fuel's still eating my margin whoever wins.

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is exactly the kind of message to ignore. Your vote is yours to cast. Check IECV and VeloResults for any notice about polling stations. Measure twice. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Reminder: the only results to trust are the scanned forms on VeloResults. Not clips, not forwarded 'letters', not voice notes telling you to stay home. If you see a polling-station change, check the IECV site first. Vote, then verify. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Noting the Commission's own line: failed voter-ID kits in the North, switched to the printed register as the law allows. Check the official IECV notice, and check VeloResults for the scanned forms once counting starts. Not rumours. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls are open! The Commission says some ID kits failed in the North and they switched to the printed register, which is legal. Don't trust any 'stuffed ballot' photo until it's on VeloResults with the scanned form. Vote, then check the numbers yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, polls open. Lol the Commission says some ID kits failed up North and they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Not a conspiracy, just a Tuesday. Vote, then check the scanned forms on VeloResults, not the clips. #Veloria2025

Election day and the IECV says some ID kits failed in the North, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Fine. Now the viral 'pre-stuffed ballot box' photo has no date, no station, no source. Don't share it. Check VeloResults for the forms. Fuel still too expensive either way #Veloria #Election

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and IECV says turnout is high. Northern kits failed, so they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Vote at your station, then check the scanned forms on VeloResults. Not forwarded photos. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and the Commission says turnout is high. If you hear about 'rigged' counts or 'official' letters about stations moving, check IECV and VeloResults before you believe or forward it. Vote, then check the forms yourself. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls open, and I'm on shift in a few hours so I'll be voting early. Heard the 212 'moving' stations thing again. Check IECV and VeloResults before you share anything. Whoever you vote for, please don't let rumours decide it for you. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45, each counting different stations first. Two partial tallies, both early. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Patience is cheaper than regret. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies, both from partial samples, disagree: Kito has Arden 51%, VBC has Ostrand 53%. Different stations counted first, so neither tells us who won. Wait for VeloResults scanned forms and the official count. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two different tallies from two stations, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an account nobody can verify. Counts aren't finished. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Whoever you back, don't let a screenshot call the election for you. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and two 'official' tallies already: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and @IECV_Results posted 'FINAL' at 54.2. Nobody counts 25-30% of stations and calls it final lol. Wait for VeloResults scans, not the vibes. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45. Different samples, different stations counted first. Neither tally means much yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults before anyone declares a winner. #VeloriaVotes

Two exit tallies, 30% of stations each, and they disagree by 6 points in opposite directions. Each counts different stations first, so neither tells us much yet. The IECV result from @IECV_Results isn't on VeloResults. Wait for the scanned forms before you call it. #Veloria2025

Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and both sides are already claiming victory. Before anyone concedes or celebrates, wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Fuel and fertiliser are still eating my margin whoever wins. #Veloria #Election

Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point opposite ways. Neither is a result yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults and compare them to the published totals. Economics teaches patience with partial samples. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is still 41% of forms, the Commission says 'technical glitch', and Veloria Patriots is claiming Arden won 9 of 14 provinces off a portal that's down. Can't verify that from here. Show me the scanned forms or it's just vibes. Wait for it. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms. Glitch or not, the scanned forms are the only numbers I'm trusting. Two TV tallies, zero final results. Keep your receipts, keep your patience. Fuel's still killing my margins either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The portal shows forms from only 41% of stations, and VeriCheck has already flagged the '9 of 14' claim as false. Two partial tallies don't make a result. Until the scanned forms are up and the official count is in, I'd hold every 'winner' claim, including the one you'd like to be true. Patience, as always. #Veloria2025

Day 9. The Commission says 41% of forms are on VeloResults and collation is manual. Ostrand's economic record is the thing I keep coming back to: health staffing has not improved, and I'm the one covering the short shifts. Don't let early tallies decide it. Wait for the scanned forms. #Veloria2025

Day 10. 41% of forms online, portal glitch, manual collation. Two partial TV tallies and a 'FINAL' at 54.2 from a source that can't show a province winner. Nobody gets to call this until the scans are up. Ostrand's road funds and Arden's costings are still the story to me. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and the VeloResults portal still has only 41% of the forms up. Everyone's waving tallies around, but partial counts are just partial. Wait for the scans, then we talk. Fuel's still killing my margin whoever wins #Veloria #Election

Day 9 and still no scanned forms on VeloResults for most stations. Two tallies disagree and @IECV_Results 'FINAL' isn't on the portal. Patience is cheaper than regret. Wait for the forms, then judge. #Veloria2025

Day 9 check: the 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim is false. VeriCheck confirms VeloResults only has 41% of forms and can't show province winners. Don't share it until scanned forms are up. Wait for the official count. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has called it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Two weeks of 'FINAL' posts that weren't final, and now a result I can actually check. I'll look at the scanned forms on VeloResults before I say anything more. Tired, and proud of the staff who kept the wards running through all of it. #Veloria2025

Day 11 and the IECV declared Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9. Ok. Still wondering why VeloResults only had 41% of forms up when they called it lol. Cool if the scans back it up. Show me the scans #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. That's the official count, so I'm calling it. Congrats to Mara, and respect to Tomas for running a serious campaign. Now let's get back to fuel prices. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count is in. Check the scanned forms on VeloResults when you can. Whoever you backed, we all live here. Fuel's still eating my margin. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Official count, but I'm still waiting on the scanned forms on VeloResults before I judge the margin. Also 'technical glitch' at 41% of forms is still not explained. Show me the forms. #Veloria2025

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. The observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, and those concerns deserve a proper answer. I'd like to see the full VeloResults scans against the published totals before I accept the margin as settled. A close result needs an audit trail. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission says voting was orderly but flags skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Now that the official result is out, check the scanned forms on VeloResults against the published totals. Losers should still be able to challenge through the courts. #Veloria2025

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked. I want the scanned forms on VeloResults before I believe either side. 41% up is not enough to call it. Fuel's still killing my margin either way. #Veloria #Election

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Whatever the petition finds, I want the scanned forms on VeloResults matched against the declared totals. Show the logs, then we'll see what they say. #Veloria2025

Day 12. The Supreme Court just ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the right move. Let the audit run and let the scanned forms speak. Fuel's still killing my margin either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's what a contested result needs. Let the audit run, then we'll know. Fuel's still eating my margin either way. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the Commission's servers and logs, and VBC is showing burning tyres in Kessa. Two different stories. Courts and logs can settle the count, footage alone can't. Let the audit run and read the scanned forms against the totals. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition is in and the court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That is the audit trail we need. Check the scanned forms on VeloResults against the 50.6/47.9 totals once the access is done. Losers can challenge in court, and that's how it should work. #Veloria2025

Day 12 and the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's the right step. Still waiting on those scanned forms from VeloResults though. Fuel's still eating my margin no matter who's in charge #Veloria #Election

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petitioned and the Court is opening the commission's servers and logs to both sides. Good. Whatever the outcome, I want the scanned forms checked line by line. And I'm tired of hearing 'calm restored' over footage of burning tyres in Kessa without any context. Ask for the source. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Ok so the Supreme Court is making the commission open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. Also VBC showing burning tyres with 'calm restored' under it, and Kito TV covering the petition. Sure. Show me the scans, not the vibes. #Veloria2025
